story.iWant: the system to automatically extract text from my uploaded documents, including scanned PDFs and images
story.soThat: I can use my handwritten notes and non-digital study materials for generating summaries and quizzes
story.tasks: - Setup & Configuration (Add deps: google-cloud-vision, pypdf, python-docx, rq) - Implement OCR Service (Hybrid strategy: pypdf + GCV fallback) - Implement Background Worker (process_document task) - API Integration (Enqueue job on upload) - Error Handling & Logging

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - Scenario 1: Native PDF Extraction (Fast Path) - Use pypdf, no GCV call - Scenario 2: Scanned PDF/Image Extraction (OCR Path) - Detect low density, use GCV - Scenario 3: Asynchronous Workflow - Status pending/processing, non-blocking API - Scenario 4: Error Handling - Graceful failure, status failed, logging

doc.title: Technical Specification: Epic 3
doc.snippet: Strategy: PDF (pypdf -> density check -> OCR), Images (Direct OCR), DOCX (python-docx). OCR Provider: Google Cloud Vision API.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Worker picks up job. Text Extraction: If native PDF -> local libs. If image/scanned -> GCV. Analysis -> LLM. Save -> DB.

doc.title: Epics
doc.snippet: As a user, I want the system to be able to read text from scanned documents, so that I can use my handwritten notes.
